title: Compose daily check-in and observation in the PWA

gates.name: daily_check_in_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/daily-check-in.spec.ts

verify: Independent Engineer browser verification covers only the check-in prompt and daily check-in/observation command, including exact fields, authoritative failures, and reread.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-017 RED: no Engineer browser integration exists for the check-in prompt and daily check-in/observation command; GREEN: exact authorized check-in succeeds while empty/text-length/permission/archive cases remain safe non-mutating backend failures; decisive comparison: request body, response/DOM state, and authoritative reread; artifact: check-in evidence under .tasks/TASK-083-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Make the accepted daily check-in and observation result usable from the selected-Plant workspace without moving ActorContext, attribution, or audit authority into the PWA.
success_outcome: An authorized Engineer can load the prompt and submit the exact daily check-in/observation shape, while validation, permission, and archive failures remain non-mutating and safely presented.
anti_goals: Do not add standalone pH/EC measurement UI, sensor runtime, advice generation, Safety approval, Task creation, or frontend-derived attribution.
Do not adopt provider-owned persistence, Timeline, Dataset, or freshness proof.

forbidden_scope: backend Plant Operations, ActorContext, Timeline, or Dataset authority
stop_conditions: A required input or result is absent from Plant Operations HTTP and would require a new product contract.
The PWA would need to infer current authorization, attribution, or freshness.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Plant Operations remains the only command/data owner.
Use exact backend fields and safe errors; no optimistic state may outlive a failed request.
invariants: Archived or unauthorized Plant operations never mutate state.
Frontend state never becomes Plant evidence, audit attribution, agent context, or Safety authority.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-017: check-in prompt and exact daily check-in/observation success plus validation, permission, and archive failures.
T3 harm proof uses isolated Plant state, safe rerun identities, and cleanup proving no denied-request residue.
